title: Studio 154 Hotel - City View Double King
description:
Enjoy the view of Nashville's 2nd Avenue from this Double King Suite. With two king-sized beds, this suite offers a blend of modern luxury with 12 ft ceilings and breathtaking 10 ft arched windows.

Other things to note
Studio 154 Hotel is located in a row of historic brick buildings. Due to its uniqueness, some rooms do not have windows. It is important that you review the photos of each room and ask the hotel if you have questions about the room prior to booking.
